answer: Each identity binds one EEG headset and passes a 12-minute brainwave challenge monthly: a spiral stimulus flashes 40 patterns, recording the unique P300 response. A 25 POA bond locks 90 days; two missed challenges forfeit half the bond and freeze payouts 3 epochs. 100 fakes need 100 headsets at $120 each plus 2,500 POA locked; a 10 POA calibration fee doubles every 10 headsets from one funder, so the 100th fake pays 5,120 POA fees. A bridge relay forwards signed hashes on-chain; verifiers replay each quill record and reject mismatched responses. Shared headsets need a joint in-person check.
